meta.name: CCNL Lavoro Domestico — DOMINA/FIDALDO/ASSINDATCOLF (conviventi a orario ridotto, art. 14 c. 2)

family.reason: Domestic work, live-in with reduced hours.

signatories: DOMINA — Associazione Nazionale Famiglie Datori di Lavoro Domestico
FIDALDO — Federazione Italiana Datori di Lavoro Domestico
ASSINDATCOLF — Associazione Nazionale dei Datori di Lavoro Domestico

notes.text: SALARY MODEL: TABELLA B of the CCNL of 28/10/2025, conviventi hired under art. 14 c. 2 (levels C, B and B super, up to 30 weekly hours, written act of c. 3). The monthly minimum is paid 'qualunque sia l'orario di lavoro osservato nel limite massimo delle 30 ore settimanali', so it is not proportioned to the hours and more than 30 weekly hours are rejected; board and lodging are due in full ('fermo restando l'obbligo di corresponsione dell'intera retribuzione in natura'). Values of 2026: B 702,25 (the signed text prints 702,35, the DOMINA and Commissione tables 702,25), BS 737,39, C 814,60.

HOURLY DIVISOR: 130 = 30 x 52 / 12 in the file; a run uses the weekly hours of the employment x 52 / 12 (flat_pay_max_weekly_hours), since the Tabella B pay does not change with the hours: B super at 10 weekly hours is 737,39 / 43,33 = 17,02 an hour. Work beyond the agreed hours is paid at the hourly retribuzione globale di fatto (art. 14 c. 2): classify hours within the adopted time arrangement as supplementare (zero supplement), and hours outside it as weekday, night or holiday for the art. 15 supplements; do not infer the arrangement from the calendar date alone.
SENIORITY: biennale, 4% of the Tabella B minimum (art. 37 c. 1: 'sulla retribuzione minima contrattuale'), maximum 7 scatti: B 28,09, BS 29,50, C 32,58.

NOT MODELLED: students aged 16 to 40 (art. 14 c. 2) at levels other than C, B and B super, for whom Tabella B has no value. The 2026 monthly allowances of Tables H (BS, 97.06) and L (B and BS, 30.27) are encoded for caller-attested eligible roles; child age, certification validity and absorption by better individual pay cannot be inferred from the role alone.

limitation.remediation: Source the Tabella B values for the other student levels. For modeled levels, supply eligible roles only after checking child age, certification conditions and any offset against individual pay.

notes.text: TAX SECTOR: lavoro-domestico (TaxSector.LAVORO_DOMESTICO). Flat per-hour INPS contributions from INPS Circ. 9/2026. A household employer is not a withholding agent: it is not among the sostituti d'imposta of art. 23 c. 1 D.P.R. 600/1973 (art. 33 c. 1 D.Lgs. 33/2025 from 2027), so the engine withholds no IRPEF or surtax and pays no trattamento integrativo, ulteriore detrazione or somma esente.
ADDITIONAL MONTHS: 13 (tredicesima mensilita, Art. 39 CCNL 28/10/2025). No quattordicesima for domestic workers.
APPRENTICESHIP: none. Domestic workers are excluded from D.lgs. 81/2015 Art. 47 apprenticeship provisions.

INPS BAND: the engine chooses the band of up to 24 weekly hours on the paga oraria effettiva of INPS (circ. 9/2026; INPS page Contributi e agevolazioni fiscali per chi assume un lavoratore domestico): the monthly pay with board and lodging over the hours of the employment (weekly hours x 52 / 12), raised by the tredicesima (x 13 / 12). The 2026 bands match the published quarterly worked examples of CCNL signatory DOMINA (review of 2026-10-16); the caller must still state the actual monthly pay and contributable hours.

limitation.remediation: Resolved: the effective hourly pay and rate selection match the published 2026 worked quarters of CCNL signatory DOMINA.

source_document.title: INPS circolare n. 9 del 3 febbraio 2026

location.section: 2. Importo dei contributi, table A
location.quote: fino a € 9,61

provenance.transformation: The INPS bands and hourly rates match the existing bundled test of DOMINA's four published 2026 quarters; the worked examples are on associazionedomina.it/contributi-inps/ (sha256 0df958782e915bf7d997ea78d2ec8432536024436e434ef2b76264b356fe4ad9).

notes.text: BOARD AND LODGING: every level carries the allowance vitto_alloggio, the valore convenzionale of board and lodging provided in kind (Art. 36 c. 3, Tabella F 2026: 2,33 + 2,33 + 2,00 per day, x 30 = 199,80 per month). A regular run pays no cash for it and counts it in the TFR base (Art. 41 c. 1); the tredicesima pays it in cash (Art. 39 c. 1, chiarimento a verbale 5). It is not reduced for reduced hours (Art. 14 c. 2: intera retribuzione in natura).
CAS.SA.COLF: contributi di assistenza contrattuale of Art. 54 c. 2, 0,06 EUR per paid hour, 0,02 withheld from the worker and 0,04 paid by the employer, charged on the contributable hours of the run.

The cash indennita sostitutiva of board and lodging is not paid for the days the convivente does not take them: ferie (Art. 17 c. 7), sospensioni extraferiali (Art. 18 c. 1), congedo matrimoniale (Art. 24 c. 2), malattia and infortunio outside hospital (Art. 27 c. 9, Art. 29 c. 7). The request states those days with BoardLodgingEvent, and the engine pays the value in kind over 30 for each of them.

limitation.remediation: Resolved: BoardLodgingEvent states the days without board and lodging of the month; the engine pays the value in kind over 30 times the days (Art. 36 c. 3).

notes.text: The INPS contributions of the tredicesima are paid on the hours of the year: INPS bands them on the paga oraria effettiva, which spreads the tredicesima over the hours, so the tredicesima run charges no INPS hours. The Cas.Sa.Colf contribution of Art. 54 c. 2 is charged on the contributable hours the run states, a tredicesima run too: no bundled source says whether the tredicesima carries hours of its own for it.

limitation.remediation: Source from the Cas.Sa.Colf rules whether the tredicesima carries contributable hours and set them for extra-month runs.

notes.text: SICKNESS (Art. 27): INPS pays no indemnity to domestic workers; the employer pays 50% of the retribuzione globale di fatto up to the third day and 100% from the fourth, for at most 8, 10 or 15 days in the 365 days that end on the sick day, within a comporto of 10, 45 or 180 days, for up to 6 months of seniority, up to 2 years and over 2 years. A sick day is a thirtieth of the monthly pay (chiarimento a verbale 2).

Art. 27 c. 6: the comporto is 50% longer for an oncological illness certified by the ASL. The episode can state a serious illness (SicknessEpisode.serious_illness), but the domestic sickness rules have no serious-illness rule, so the engine keeps the ordinary comporto (review of 2026-10-30).

limitation.remediation: Resolved: the bands carry the comporto of an oncological illness (serious_comporto_days 15, 68 and 270 days, the periods of c. 4 raised by 50%), applied when the episode states SicknessEpisode.serious_illness; 45 x 1.5 = 67.5 is read as 68, the 68th day being still in part within the period.

notes.text: Art. 27 c. 9: the conventional value of board and lodging is added to the sick pay only when the worker is not in hospital or in the employer's home. The sick pay is thirtieths of the cash monthly pay, without the value in kind; the sick days spent elsewhere are stated with BoardLodgingEvent, which pays that value in cash.

limitation.remediation: Resolved: the sick pay leaves the value in kind out, and BoardLodgingEvent pays it for the sick days outside hospital and the employer's home.

notes.text: NIGHT WORK (Art. 14 c. 6): ordinary work between 22.00 and 6.00 is paid with a 20% supplement of the hourly retribuzione globale di fatto; the engine takes its amount as a NightShiftEvent stated by the caller. The overtime bands are those of Art. 15 c. 3 (25% by day, 50% by night, 60% on a holiday or Sunday); night overtime on a holiday has no band of its own and a run that states it is rejected.

Art. 14 c. 2: hours beyond the agreed ones within the adopted time arrangement are paid at the plain hourly retribuzione globale di fatto (OvertimeEvent.kind=supplementare); hours outside it are classified by time of day / holiday for the supplements of Art. 15. The caller must verify the written arrangement and split hours crossing its boundary into separate events.

limitation.remediation: Resolved for caller-classified hours: use kind=supplementare for extra hours within the written arrangement and weekday/night/holiday for hours outside it; split hours at the arrangement boundary.

notes.text: ANNUAL MINIMI: the minimi of the CCNL are updated every year from 1 January by the Commissione nazionale (Art. 38, ISTAT variation of the consumer prices); the bundle holds the table of 2026. From 1 January 2027 the amounts are those of 2026 until the 2027 table is published and added, so a 2027 run is not payable.

limitation.remediation: Add the minimi of 2027 set by the Commissione nazionale with their source, then remove this note.

notes.text: Art. 34 cc. 3 and 7: the engine pays the level-specific allowances only while the caller states the qualifying roles. It cannot independently verify a child's age or certification validity, written notice and delivery of its copy. Nor does it automatically offset the allowance of c. 3 against an individual superminimo or that of c. 7 against better treatment received overall; the caller must state individual pay net of any offset. The c. 4 allowance is restricted to C super and D super, outside this reduced-hours file.

limitation.remediation: Verify role eligibility externally and state individual pay net of any offset; to automate this, model child age, certification validity and notice, and the applicable offsets.

source_document.title: CCNL sulla disciplina del rapporto di lavoro domestico, 28 ottobre 2025 (testo Assindatcolf)

location.section: Art. 27 cc. 4-7 (malattia); chiarimento a verbale 2 (giorni di calendario in trentesimi)
location.quote: decorre in caso di malattia la retribuzione globale di fatto per un massimo di 8, 10, 15 giorni complessivi nell'anno

provenance.transformation: INPS pays domestic workers no sickness indemnity, so the employer pays the CCNL rate: 50% up to the third consecutive day (the carenza) and 100% from the fourth, for at most 8, 10 or 15 days and within a comporto of 10, 45 or 180 days, for up to 6 months of seniority, from 6 months to 2 years and over 2 years (bands from 0, 6 and 24 months). Readings: 'nell'anno' of c. 7 is taken as the period of 365 days of c. 5, and the 365 days 'decorrenti dall'evento' as the year that ends on the sick day; a day past the paid days is unpaid; the daily pay is a thirtieth of the monthly pay (chiarimento a verbale 2: 'giorni di calendario' are thirtieths, 'esempio: malattia'). An oncological illness documented by the ASL (c. 6, SicknessEpisode.serious_illness) keeps the post 50% longer: 15, 68 and 270 days (45 x 1.5 = 67.5, the 68th day still in part within the period); the paid days of c. 7 do not change.

reviews.scope: Whole file. The values checked were not recorded.
findings: The review recorded no list of the documents it read.

reviews.scope: Every payable rule of the file: minimums, hourly divisor, additional months, seniority, Cas.Sa.Colf, overtime, absences, leave and the accrual of the tredicesima, read in the signed text of 28 October 2025 and its 2026 table (p. 59); the sickness rule of Art. 27 stays derived (readings in its transformation).
findings: Overtime: the file held 10% and 20%; Art. 15 c. 3 sets 25% by day, 50% by night and 60% on a holiday or Sunday. The 20% of Art. 14 c. 6 is the supplement of ordinary night work, not of overtime.
accrual_rule was missing: chiarimento a verbale 4 counts a fraction of a month of at least 15 calendar days as a whole month.
Citations moved from the DOMINA table and section labels without page to the signed text with page and quote.

Tabella B, level B: the file held 702,35 as printed in the signed text; the DOMINA table of 2026 and the table of the Commissione of 11 February 2026 print 702,25. Corrected to 702,25 and left derived; the seniority step (4%) is 28,09 either way.

reviews.scope: Limitation hourly_inps_bracket_unvalidated: the band of the hourly INPS contribution up to 24 weekly hours against the worked quarters of a signatory of the CCNL (DOMINA) and INPS circ. 9/2026.
findings: INPS circ. 9/2026 downloaded again on 2026-10-16: same sha256 as the bundle, no rectification in the text; the 2026 amounts of the file stand.

DOMINA states that the paga oraria effettiva includes the hourly share of the tredicesima and prints four quarters of 2026 (13 weeks): colf 10 h at 8.00 an hour, 1.70, 221.00 (worker 55.90); colf 10 h at 9.00, 1.92 because 9 x 13 / 12 = 9.75 is above 9.61, 249.60 (62.40); colf 25 h, 1.24, 403.00 (100.75); badante convivente 54 h, 1.24, 870.48 (217.62). The engine's effective pay and band match all four (tests/mutation/ccnl_engine/contribution/domestic/services/test_effective_hourly_pay.py::test_the_band_of_the_published_quarters_of_a_signatory): the raise by 13/12 is validated.

Still unvalidated, so the limitation stays: the share of board and lodging in the effective pay of a convivente up to 24 weekly hours. DOMINA states it ('per chi ha vitto e alloggio, il loro valore convenzionale'), as the engine computes it, but prints no worked case with board and lodging, and no worked example of a convivente up to 24 hours was found.

reviews.scope: The accrual of the ferie and their indemnity at the end of the employment, Art. 17 and Chiarimenti a verbale (PDF pp. 29-30, 56).
findings: Art. 17 c. 9 and Chiarimenti point 4: twelfths for each month of service, a month of 15 days or more whole: work_rules.leave_rules.ferie_accrual. Art. 17 c. 6: a day of ferie is paid 1/26 of the monthly pay, read as the indemnity of a day left: work_rules.leave_rules.termination. Found by a delegated search, read again in the PDF text layer.

reviews.scope: Art. 34 cc. 3, 4, 7 (PDF pp. 44-45) and the Tabelle H, I, L of the minimi from 1 January 2026 (PDF p. 59), text layer.
findings: Tabella H: B super baby sitter 138.54 a month (live-in), 97.06 (Tabella B workers), 0.84 an hour; Tabella I: C super and D super assisting more than one non self-sufficient person 119.66 a month, 0.70 an hour; Tabella L: B, B super and C super with the UNI 11766:2019 certification 30.27 a month: role allowances of the levels of this ruleset.

reviews.scope: Verified the existing 2026 Table H and L allowances and narrowed the obsolete limitation to missing student levels and caller-attested eligibility.
findings: The cached signed PDF page 59 gives 97.06 monthly for BS in Table H and 30.27 monthly for B and BS in Table L; the existing level-local allowances already implement these values.
Child age and certification evidence are caller-attested roles; offsets against individual pay remain outside the fixed allowance model.

reviews.scope: Art. 34 cc. 3, 4, 7 and the Tabelle H, I, L (PDF pp. 44-45, 59) against the role allowances, by a separate model session.
findings: Confirmed the amounts, levels and roles of the Tabelle H, I and L.

Corrected: the quotes now hold the article text alone (the table amounts are in the transformation); the certification needs a copy handed over; the allowance of c. 7 is absorbed by any better treatment received overall, not only a superminimo.

reviews.scope: Art. 14 c. 2, PDF pp. 24-25, Art. 14 c. 6 and Art. 15 c. 3, PDF pp. 26-27: extra hours within and outside the adopted arrangement and night hours.
findings: Within-arrangement additional hours receive the hourly global actual remuneration without a supplement; outside hours receive Art. 15 supplements. The caller classifies and splits events at the arrangement boundary; ordinary night work remains a separate 20% supplement.

reviews.scope: Art. 34 cc. 3, 4, 7 (PDF pp. 44-45) against caller-gated role allowances and offsets.
findings: Role-gated monthly allowances work for B and BS; independent eligibility checks and automatic offsets remain outside the model. C super and D super are outside this file.

reviews.scope: INPS circolare 9/2026 table A (PDF p. 3) and published DOMINA quarters against the existing domestic rate test.
findings: The example-validation gap was already closed by four published DOMINA quarters in the bundled mutation test.
